senses.gloss: निश् f. night.

नि॑स् prep. out of, away from (abl.), mostly ˚— as prep. or
neg. pref. (cf. 2 अ) in subst. & adj.
निश (—˚) n. & निशा f. the same.
निशाकर m. the moon (night-maker).
निशागम m. evening, coming of night.

निशाचर a. night-walking;
 m. a Rakṣas (f. ई).
निशात्यय m. close of night, day-break.
निशाधीश m. the moon (lord of night).
निशानाथ m. the same.
निशानिशम् adv. day by day (lit. night by n.).
1 निशान्त a. tested, approved, usual, customary.
2 निशान्त n. dwelling-place, house.
3 निशान्त s. close of night, day-break.
निशापति m. = निशाधीश.
निशाम m. ˚न n. observing, perceiving.
निशामुख n. the face or the coming of the night.

नि॑शित a. sharpened, whetted;
 eager for (loc.).
नि॑शिता f. night.
निशिताङ्कुश s. a sharp or pointed book.
नि॑शिति f. stimulation, invitation, entertainment, treat.
निशीथ m. (n.) midnight, night i.g.
निशीथदीप m. night lamp.
निशुम्भ m. killing, slaughter, N. of a Dānava.

निश्चय m. ascertainment, conviction, persuasion,
decision, resolution, fixed opinion or purpose.
निश्चल a. immovable, invariable.
निश्चिन्त a. thoughtless, careless, unconcerned.

निश्चेतन a. unconscious, unreasonable;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
निश्चेतस् a. = prec. a.

निश्चेष्ट a. motionless;
 n. adv.
निश्छन्दस् a. not studying the Veda.

निश्छिद्र a. having no rent, openings, or weak points;
whole, complete, uninterrupted.
नि॑श्वसित n. breathing out.
निश्वास m. breathing in or out, sigh.

नि॑षक्त a. hanging on, clinging to, sitting in, turned
towards (—˚).
नि॑षत्त a. seated.
निषत्त॑ a. seated.
नि॑षत्ति f. sitting, seat.
निषत्स्नु॑ a. sitting fast.

निष॑दन n. sitting down;
 seat, abode.
निषद्वर॑ a. sitting (inactive or near the altar).
निषाद॑ m. Non-Aryan, barbarian.

निषिद्ध a. kept off, prohibited, forbidden (pers. &
th.).
निषिद्धि f. keeping off.
निषूदक m. killer, destroyer.
निषू˚दन m. killer, destroyer.
निषे॑चन n. pouring out, sprinkling.
निषेद्धव्य a. to be kept off or back.
निषेद्धृ॑ m. who keeps off.

निषेध m. keeping off, prohibition^1 (also ˚न n.);
 denial,
negation, contradiction.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
निषेधिन् a. repelling, beating (—˚).
निषेध्य a. = निषेद्धव्य.

निषेवित a. inhabited, frequented, tenanted, occupied,
approached, enjoyed.
निषेवितव्य a. = निषेव्य.
निषेविन् a. practising, observing, enjoying (—˚).
निषेव्य a. to be practised, observed, or enjoyed.
निष्कण्टक a. free from thorns or enemies.
निष्कर a. free from duties or taxes.
निष्करुण a. pitiless, cruel (abstr. ˚ता f.*).
निष्कर्मन् a. inactive.
निष्कलङ्क a. stainless, sinless, pure.
निष्कल्मष a. = prec. a.
नि॑ष्काम a. desireless, disinterested.
निष्कासन n. expulsion, driving away.
निष्कासनीय a. to be driven away.
निष्किंचन a. having nothing, poor.
निष्कुट m. n. grove, pleasure-ground.
निष्कुतूहल a. free from curiosity.
निष्कुल a. having no family, single.
निष्कूज a. soundless, mute.

निष्कृत॑ n. expiation;
 fixed place, rendezvous.

नि॑ष्कृति f. restoration, healing;
 also = prec.
निष्कृप a. pitiless, cruel.
निष्कोश a. unsheathed.

निष्क्रम m. ˚ण n. going out (esp. for the first time
with a child).
निष्क्र॑यण a. & n. redeeming, ransoming.

निष्क्रान्त a. gone out;
 exit, exeunt (d.).

निष्क्रियात्मन् a. inactive, lazy;
 abstr. ˚त्मता f.
नि॑ष्क्रीति f. redemption.
निष्क्रोध a. not angry with (gen.).
निष्टाप m. warmth.
निष्टु॑र् a. throwing down, felling.
नि॑ष्ट्य a. external, foreign.
निष्ठा॑ a. excelling, leading.
निष्ठावन्त् a. perfect, consummate.
निष्ठाशून्य a. wanting firmness, unsteady.
1 निष्ठित a. standing on, being in (loc.).
2 निष्ठित a. grown forth, risen, accomplished, ready.

निष्ठीवन n. ˚विका f., ˚वित n. spitting out,
spittle.

निष्ठ्यूत a. bespat;
 n. spittle.
निष्ण a. clever, skilful, versed in (—˚).

निष्णात a. the same (also w. loc.);
 agreed upon, settled.
निष्पतन n. rushing forth.
निष्पत्ति f. coming out or forth, completion, result.
निष्प॑द् f. excrement.
निष्पद a. footless.
1 निष्पन्द m. motion.

2 निष्पन्द a. motionless;
 ˚न्दी@कृ make m.
निष्परामर्श a. incapable of thinking.
निष्पर्यन्त a. unlimited.

निष्पादक a. accomplishing;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
निष्पादनीय a. to be accomplished.
निष्पाद्य a. to be accomplished.
निष्पाप a. sinless.
निष्पार a. boundless, unlimited.
निष्पीडन n. pressure.
निष्पुत्र a. sonless.
निष्पुरुष a. destitute of men (males), unpeopled.
निष्पेष m. ˚ण n. clashing against, bounce, shock.
निष्प्रज्ञ a. ignorant, stupid.
निष्प्रताप a. void of dignity.
निष्प्रत्यूह a. unimpeded, unlimited.
निष्प्रवाणि a. fresh from the loom, quite new (cloth).

निष्प्राण a. breathless, exhausted;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
निष्प्रीति a. joyless, not rejoicing in (—˚).
निष्फली@कृ leave unrewarded.
निष्फार m. yawning, gaping.
निष्फेन a. foamless.
निष्यन्द v. निस्यन्द & ˚न्दिन्.
निष्य˚न्दिन् v. निस्यन्द & ˚न्दिन्.
निष्यन्दिन् a. = prec. adj., also trans. (—˚).
निस्यन्दिन् a. = prec. adj., also trans. (—˚).
निष्ष॑ह् a. overpowering, powerful.
(निष्˚षा॑ह्) a. overpowering, powerful.
नीष॑ह् (नी˚षा॑ह्) a. overpowering.
निसर्गज a. innate, natural, originally given by (—˚).
निसर्गनिपुण a. clever by nature.
निसर्गशालीन a. modest by nature.
निसर्गसौहृद n. natural friendship.
निस्तमस्क a. free from darkness, light.

निस्तरण n. passing over;
 escape, rescue.
निस्तारण n. passing over, overcoming.
निस्तार m. = prec. + payment, acquittance.
निस्तेजस् a. deprived of splendour or energy.

निस्त्रिंश a. cruel, merciless (lit. more than thirty),
abstr. ˚त्व n. — m. a sword, p. ˚शिन्.
निस्त्रिंशकर्कश a. cruel and hard.

निस्त्रैगुण्य a. exempt from the three qualities
(ph.).
निस्रव m. flowing down, stream, torrent.
निस्राव m. flowing down, stream, torrent.
निस्वन m. sound, noise, voice.
निस्वनित n. the same.
निस्वर॑ a. noiseless, mute.
नीशार m. a blanket or shawl.
